description: Fixed daily suite (#213), same scale as the #180 acceptance repro. Lower is better. cold-open and delete use 600 commits and 200 nodes; catalog lists 200 extra projects built with 3 nodes so the number is listing cost, not another history replay. UI metrics are the same nightly run's drag frame p95 (reference_drag_performance.mjs). Render-probe duration is kept on the artifact for the trend and is not a regression metric; docs/development/ui-performance.md budgets are a reading reference, not this failure line. Baseline metrics stay empty until an ubuntu-22.04 nightly sample is copied in. Until then the regression reference is the previous run. A metric regresses only when it is slower than that reference by both regressionRatio and its minDeltaMs.

baseline.note: Seed metrics from a daily-benchmark.json artifact produced on the nightly runner. Do not copy a developer-machine timing.
